name: Snoopy
author: zhou-jianwen
variant_note: An independently AI-generated flat-cartoon V2 fan interpretation with nine task animations and sixteen clockwise look directions, prepared for community request #318 and duplicate #319.
description: An unofficial, independently AI-generated Snoopy fan companion. A small upright white beagle with black floppy ears and an elongated muzzle. zhou-jianwen is credited only as the independent AI-assisted adapter, not the character creator or reference artist.
source_notes: Duplicate community requests #318 and #319 refer to the same Peanuts character and are covered by one independently generated asset. The requester-uploaded PNG (https://api.codexpet.top/uploads/reference/references/b5cd5582d376a01788c333d12ac7ec8994d52e6df9823a4621f6ada803409c95.png) supplies appearance guidance only; its original artist, original publication and redistribution permission could not be established from that upload. Official identity was checked at https://www.peanuts.com/about/snoopy . The second request links https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Snoopy_Peanuts.png ; that file page describes a non-free image and warns about the cited source, so it is not treated as reusable licensed material. No supplied or Wikipedia reference pixels are committed, and zhou-jianwen is not credited as their author. Submitter production-triage decision: generate an independent fan interpretation, disclose unresolved reference attribution, and leave rights and curation acceptance to maintainers before merge. Sprite pixels were generated with the built-in image_gen tool, followed by native-alpha extraction, intact whole-pose retiling for spacing and deterministic V2 assembly. The left locomotion animation is a framewise horizontal mirror of the approved right animation for this symmetric design, preserving temporal order.
